limits: All workloads are host fixtures, no real Rust build or QEMU/kernel run in this subtask.
Public supervisor must receive cooperative INT/TERM to clean its private worker session; uncatchable SIGKILL cannot run cleanup.
Composed debug calls must use the explicit worker route so parent OwnedSession remains sole group owner.
Group cleanup assumes this supervisor is sole direct-leader reaper; ECHILD fails closed without numeric group guesses.
No /proc identity heuristics, subreaper, global process kills or core/OSTD changes.
